set.description: 从 n 个不同元素中取出 k 个成一组，只看元素、不看顺序，叫做组合。
set.name: Concept of combinations

criteria: 能叙述性质与判定
能用其证明线段相等
set.description: 线段垂直平分线上的点到线段两端距离相等；到线段两端距离相等的点在垂直平分线上。
set.name: Properties and Criteria for the Perpendicular Bisector of a Segment
set.nameZh: 线段垂直平分线的性质与判定

criteria: 能说出平行公理及其推论
会用符号表示平行
set.description: 在同一平面内不相交的两条直线叫平行线；过直线外一点有且只有一条直线与已知直线平行；平行于同一直线的两直线平行。
set.name: Parallel Lines and the Parallel Postulate

criteria: 能计算组合数
知道 C(n,0)=1
set.description: 组合数 C(n,k)=n!/(k!(n−k)!)，也等于排列数除以 k 的阶乘。
set.name: Formula for the number of combinations

criteria: 能判断实际问题用组合而不是排列
能计算分类选取的组合数
set.description: 选人、选物且不计顺序时用组合；若还要按类别分别选取，再把组合数相乘。
set.name: Simple Applications of Combinations

criteria: 能说出线段有两个端点
知道直线没有端点、射线有一个端点
set.description: 能区分线段、直线和射线，知道两点之间线段最短。
set.name: Line Segments, Lines, and Rays

criteria: 能说出排列与顺序有关
能计算很小的排列个数
set.description: 从 n 个不同元素中取出 k 个排成一列，顺序不同算不同的排列。
set.name: Concept of permutations

criteria: 能比较线段大小
能用中点性质计算线段长度
set.description: 用度量或叠合比较线段长短，掌握线段的和差与中点概念。
set.name: Comparing and Calculating with Line Segments

set.reason: The perpendicular bisector passes through the midpoint, whose equal-half relation specifies the bisection part.
The criterion distinguishes combinations from permutations, requiring the ordered-selection concept for that contrast even though unordered selection can be introduced independently.
C(n,k) evaluates an unordered selection count; the combination concept gives the object and its non-order-sensitive meaning.
The application criterion computes unordered counts by categories, containing combination-number evaluation within those categories.
set.scope: computing unordered selection counts in applications

set.reason: A radius and diameter are segments with specified endpoints and lengths, directly using the segment concept within the larger line/ray endpoint.
set.scope: defining radius and diameter as segments

criteria: Prove a bound for every allowed configuration.
Exhibit a configuration attaining the claimed bound.
set.description: Prove a largest or smallest possible discrete configuration by combining a universal bound with an allowed construction or reachability argument attaining it.
set.name: Discrete extremal bounds and constructions

criteria: 能计算圆心距
能用圆心距和半径判断位置关系
set.description: For circles of positive radii r1,r2 and center distance d: d=r1+r2 gives external tangency; 0<d=|r1-r2| gives internal tangency; |r1-r2|<d<r1+r2 gives two intersections. If d=0 and r1=r2 the circles coincide. Outside these ranges they have no common point.
set.name: Relative positions of two circles

criteria: 能说出圆上的点到圆心的距离都等于半径
知道直径等于半径的 2 倍
set.description: 认识圆心、半径和直径，会用圆规画圆，知道同一圆里半径都相等。
set.name: Understanding Circles
